purpose: Teach: ギャップ/育ち/不信/浮気/大騒ぎ/おいしかっ/おいしく/怒る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスの新人、見た目と話し方のギャップ、すごいよね。
lines.en: The new person in our class—there's such a massive gap between how they look and how they actually talk.
lines.style: Quick, animated delivery with genuine curiosity. Leans forward slightly. Tone is conspiratorial, the kind of observation you share with someone you trust. Slight emphasis on the gap itself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お嬢様育ちらしいよ、噂では。
lines.en: From what people say, they were raised in some really refined household.
lines.style: Laid-back, almost casual shrug in the voice. Not quite dismissive, but the tone of someone relaying secondhand gossip. Light and unburdened.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、不信感持たれて、ちょっと大騒ぎになってた。
lines.en: Yesterday it got weird—people started doubting her, and it kind of blew up into this whole thing.
lines.style: Quieter here, more measured. Slight hesitation, like she's working through the memory. Sympathetic undertone. Not gossiping, observing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 浮気を疑われた男子もいたんだろ?みんな怒るし。
lines.en: Some guy even got accused of cheating because of it, and yeah, everyone was pretty angry.
lines.style: Knowing tone—he's connecting dots. Not judgmental, just stating what happened with a light, understanding clarity. Still calm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当が、めちゃくちゃおいしかった。気分転換にはなった。
lines.en: But honestly, my bento was really delicious—at least that was a bright spot in all of it.
lines.style: Genuine warmth here. Brightness cuts through the heaviness of the previous moment. A small smile in the voice. Appreciative, almost grateful for the simple thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 明日もおいしく食べて、頑張ろう。
lines.en: Let's eat well again tomorrow and get through it together.
lines.style: Soft, genuine encouragement. No performance, just real support. Gentle, warm, steady. The kind of thing said looking at someone directly, meaning it.
